The ordina phase declares its categories in the content file and does NOT

eight words can fall (lupa, triumphus, Capitōlium, nepōs / Ēvander,

ferrum and scūtum are unclaimed ON PURPOSE — the river belongs to both
sides, Herculēs is a Greek honoured at Rome for ever, three of them are
things rather than sides, and the shield is the FRAME of the sort rather
than an item in it. Nothing for rules.php to know; recorded so the
integrator does not go looking for an item list.
